title: Why Don't Chinese People Like Relatives Anymore?
synopsis: Explore the shifting dynamics of family relationships in modern China, where rapid urbanization and changing lifestyles are leading young people to question the traditional importance of relatives.

fullText.simplified:
为什么中国人不喜欢亲戚了？

    很多人都知道中国人很重视家庭，亲戚多、交往多是中国家庭的一大特点。特别是在春节、中秋节的时候，亲戚们聚在一起，是很重要的家庭活动。但近几年来，中国的年轻人却越来越讨厌亲戚了，这是为什么呢？
    亲戚，在中国是指有血缘关系的人，包括爷爷、奶奶、叔叔、阿姨等。当然，叔叔的妻子、叔叔的孩子也是亲戚，五代以内的血缘关系都是亲戚。因此，对中国人来说，有几十、几百个亲戚是很常见的情况。在以前的社会中，亲戚们往往住得不远，在结婚、生孩子、建房子等人生大事的时候，亲戚们都会来帮忙。大家互相帮助，都很快乐，因此，传统的走亲戚是一件让人感到幸福的事情。
    但是，近几十年来，中国城市化很快。很多人搬到城市里生活，跟亲戚见面的机会变少了，感情就不如以前那么亲近了。对生活在城市里的人来说，大部分生活问题都能用钱来解决，不需要亲戚们来帮忙了；另一方面，城市生活比农村生活忙，没有那么多时间跟亲戚联系。对留在农村的人来说，亲戚仍然很重要，大家愿意像以前一样相处，一起聊天、八卦。这样的变化使亲戚之间出现了一些矛盾：有人觉得亲戚没礼貌、有人觉得亲戚没人情。尤其是一些年轻人，他们觉得和不熟悉的人或是和想法不一样的人见面、吃饭、聊天，虽然这些人是亲戚，但也是件很没有意思的事，所以他们有时会讨厌亲戚。
    现在，年轻人更愿意把时间放在朋友身上，而不是跟一些关系比较远的亲戚联系，因此出现了“断亲”的现象。
fullText.traditional:
為什麼中國人不喜歡親戚了？

    很多人都知道中國人很重視家庭，親戚多、交往多是中國家庭的一大特點。特別是在春節、中秋節的時候，親戚們聚在一起，是很重要的家庭活動。但近幾年來，中國的年輕人卻越來越討厭親戚了，這是為什麼呢？
    親戚，在中國是指有血緣關係的人，包括爺爺、奶奶、叔叔、阿姨等。當然，叔叔的妻子、叔叔的孩子也是親戚，五代以內的血緣關係都是親戚。因此，對中國人來說，有幾十、幾百個親戚是很常見的情況。在以前的社會中，親戚們往往住得不遠，在結婚、生孩子、建房子等人生大事的時候，親戚們都會來幫忙。大家互相幫助，都很快樂，因此，傳統的走親戚是一件讓人感到幸福的事情。
    但是，近幾十年來，中國城市化很快。很多人搬到城市裡生活，跟親戚見面的機會變少了，感情就不如以前那麼親近了。對生活在城市裡的人來說，大部分生活問題都能用錢來解決，不需要親戚們來幫忙了；另一方面，城市生活比農村生活忙，沒有那麼多時間跟親戚聯繫。對留在農村的人來說，親戚仍然很重要，大家願意像以前一樣相處，一起聊天、八卦。這樣的變化使親戚之間出現了一些矛盾：有人覺得親戚沒禮貌、有人覺得親戚沒人情。尤其是一些年輕人，他們覺得和不熟悉的人或是和想法不一樣的人見面、吃飯、聊天，雖然這些人是親戚，但也是件很沒有意思的事，所以他們有時會討厭親戚。
    現在，年輕人更願意把時間放在朋友身上，而不是跟一些關係比較遠的親戚聯繫，因此出現了“斷親”的現象。

sentences.simplified: 特别是在春节、中秋节的时候，亲戚们聚在一起，是很重要的家庭活动。
sentences.traditional: 特別是在春節、中秋節的時候，親戚們聚在一起，是很重要的家庭活動。
sentences.pinyin: tè bié shì zài chūn jié zhōng qiū jié de shí hou qīn qi men jù zài yì qǐ shì hěn zhòng yào de jiā tíng huó dòng
sentences.english: Having many relatives and frequent interactions is a major characteristic of Chinese families.

sentences.simplified: 但近几年来，中国的年轻人却越来越讨厌亲戚了，这是为什么呢？
sentences.traditional: 但近幾年來，中國的年輕人卻越來越討厭親戚了，這是為什麼呢？

sentences.english: Especially during the Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival, relatives gathering together is an important family activity.
But in recent years, young people in China increasingly dislike their relatives. Why is this?

sentences.simplified: 亲戚，在中国是指有血缘关系的人，包括爷爷、奶奶、叔叔、阿姨等。
sentences.traditional: 親戚，在中國是指有血緣關係的人，包括爺爺、奶奶、叔叔、阿姨等。
sentences.pinyin: qīn qi zài zhōng guó shì zhǐ yǒu xuè yuán guān xì de rén bāo kuò yé ye nǎi nai shū shu ā yí děng

sentences.simplified: 当然，叔叔的妻子、叔叔的孩子也是亲戚，
sentences.traditional: 當然，叔叔的妻子、叔叔的孩子也是親戚，
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán shū shu de qī zi shū shu de hái zi yě shì qīn qi
sentences.english: In China, relatives refer to people who are related by blood, including grandparents, uncles, aunts, and so on.

sentences.simplified: 五代以内的血缘关系都是亲戚。
sentences.traditional: 五代以內的血緣關係都是親戚。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ dài yǐ nèi de xuè yuán guān xì dōu shì qīn qi
sentences.english: Of course, an uncle’s wife and an uncle’s children are also relatives.

sentences.simplified: 因此，对中国人来说，有几十、几百个亲戚是很常见的情况。
sentences.traditional: 因此，對中國人來說，有幾十、幾百個親戚是很常見的情況。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ duì zhōng guó rén lái shuō yǒu jǐ shí jǐ bǎi ge qīn qi shì hěn cháng jiàn de qíng kuàng
sentences.english: Blood relations within five generations are all considered relatives.

sentences.simplified: 在以前的社会中，亲戚们往往住得不远，
sentences.traditional: 在以前的社會中，親戚們往往住得不遠，
sentences.pinyin: zài yǐ qián de shè huì zhōng qīn qi men wǎng wǎng zhù de bù yuǎn
sentences.english: Therefore, for Chinese people, it is very common to have dozens or even hundreds of relatives.

sentences.simplified: 在结婚、生孩子、建房子等人生大事的时候，亲戚们都会来帮忙。
sentences.traditional: 在結婚、生孩子、建房子等人生大事的時候，親戚們都會來幫忙。
sentences.pinyin: zài jié hūn shēng hái zi jiàn fáng zi děng rén shēng dà shì de shí hou qīn qi men dōu huì lái bāng máng
sentences.english: In the past society, relatives often lived not far from each other.

sentences.simplified: 大家互相帮助，都很快乐，
sentences.traditional: 大家互相幫助，都很快樂，
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā hù xiāng bāng zhù dōu hěn kuài lè
sentences.english: During major life events such as getting married, having children, and building a house, relatives would come to help.

sentences.simplified: 因此，传统的走亲戚是一件让人感到幸福的事情。
sentences.traditional: 因此，傳統的走親戚是一件讓人感到幸福的事情。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ chuán tǒng de zǒu qīn qi shì yí jiàn ràng rén gǎn dào xìng fú de shì qing
sentences.english: Everyone helped each other, and they were very happy.
Therefore, the traditional practice of visiting relatives was something that made people feel happy.

sentences.simplified: 但是，近几十年来，中国城市化很快。
sentences.traditional: 但是，近幾十年來，中國城市化很快。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì jìn jǐ shí nián lái zhōng guó chéng shì huà hěn kuài

sentences.simplified: 很多人搬到城市里生活，跟亲戚见面的机会变少了，
sentences.traditional: 很多人搬到城市裡生活，跟親戚見面的機會變少了，
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén bān dào chéng shì lǐ shēng huó gēn qīn qi jiàn miàn de jī huì biàn shǎo le
sentences.english: However, in recent decades, urbanization in China has been rapid.

sentences.simplified: 感情就不如以前那么亲近了。
sentences.traditional: 感情就不如以前那麼親近了。
sentences.pinyin: gǎn qíng jiù bù rú yǐ qián nà me qīn jìn le
sentences.english: Many people move to live in the city, and the chances of meeting relatives have decreased, ..

sentences.simplified: 对生活在城市里的人来说，大部分生活问题都能用钱来解决，不需要亲戚们来帮忙了；
sentences.traditional: 對生活在城市裡的人來說，大部分生活問題都能用錢來解決，不需要親戚們來幫忙了；
sentences.pinyin: duì shēng huó zài chéng shì lǐ de rén lái shuō dà bù fen shēng huó wèn tí dōu néng yòng qián lái jiě jué bù xū yào qīn qi men lái bāng máng le
sentences.english: .. so the relationship is not as close as before.

sentences.simplified: 另一方面，城市生活比农村生活忙，没有那么多时间跟亲戚联系。
sentences.traditional: 另一方面，城市生活比農村生活忙，沒有那麼多時間跟親戚聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: lìng yì fāng miàn chéng shì shēng huó bǐ nóng cūn shēng huó máng méi yǒu nà me duō shí jiān gēn qīn qi lián xì
sentences.english: For people living in the city, most of life’s problems can be solved with money, so there’s no need for relatives to help out.

sentences.simplified: 对留在农村的人来说，亲戚仍然很重要，
sentences.traditional: 對留在農村的人來說，親戚仍然很重要，
sentences.pinyin: duì liú zài nóng cūn de rén lái shuō qīn qi réng rán hěn zhòng yào
sentences.english: On the other hand, city life is busier than rural life and there isn’t as much time to keep in touch with relatives.

sentences.simplified: 大家愿意像以前一样相处，一起聊天、八卦。
sentences.traditional: 大家願意像以前一樣相處，一起聊天、八卦。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā yuàn yì xiàng yǐ qián yí yàng xiāng chǔ yì qǐ liáo tiān bā guà
sentences.english: For those who remain in the countryside, relatives are still very important.

sentences.simplified: 这样的变化使亲戚之间出现了一些矛盾：
sentences.traditional: 這樣的變化使親戚之間出現了一些矛盾：
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng de biàn huà shǐ qīn qi zhī jiān chū xiàn le yì xiē máo dùn
sentences.english: Everyone is willing to get along as before, chatting and gossiping together.

sentences.simplified: 有人觉得亲戚没礼貌、有人觉得亲戚没人情。
sentences.traditional: 有人覺得親戚沒禮貌、有人覺得親戚沒人情。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén jué de qīn qi méi lǐ mào yǒu rén jué de qīn qi méi rén qíng
sentences.english: Such changes have led to some conflicts among relatives:

sentences.simplified: 尤其是一些年轻人，
sentences.traditional: 尤其是一些年輕人，
sentences.pinyin: yóu qí shì yì xiē nián qīng rén
sentences.english: Some feel that their relatives are impolite, while others feel that they lack human kindness.

sentences.simplified: 他们觉得和不熟悉的人或是和想法不一样的人见面、吃饭、聊天，
sentences.traditional: 他們覺得和不熟悉的人或是和想法不一樣的人見面、吃飯、聊天，
sentences.pinyin: tā men jué de hé bù shú xī de rén huò shì hé xiǎng fǎ bù yí yàng de rén jiàn miàn chī fàn liáo tiān
sentences.english: Especially for some young people, ..

sentences.simplified: 虽然这些人是亲戚，但也是件很没有意思的事，
sentences.traditional: 雖然這些人是親戚，但也是件很沒有意思的事，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán zhè xiē rén shì qīn qi dàn yě shì jiàn hěn méi yǒu yì si de shì
sentences.english: .. they feel that meeting, eating, and chatting with people they don’t know well or people with different opinions, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以他们有时会讨厌亲戚。
sentences.traditional: 所以他們有時會討厭親戚。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā men yǒu shí huì tǎo yàn qīn qi
sentences.english: ..  even though these people are relatives, is not interesting at all.
So they sometimes dislike their relatives.

sentences.simplified: 现在，年轻人更愿意把时间放在朋友身上，而不是跟一些关系比较远的亲戚联系，
sentences.traditional: 現在，年輕人更願意把時間放在朋友身上，而不是跟一些關係比較遠的親戚聯繫，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài nián qīng rén gèng yuàn yì bǎ shí jiān fàng zài péng you shēn shang ér bú shì gēn yì xiē guān xi bǐ jiào yuǎn de qīn qi lián xì

sentences.simplified: 因此出现了“断亲”的现象。
sentences.traditional: 因此出現了“斷親”的現象。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ chū xiàn le duàn qīn de xiàn xiàng
sentences.english: Nowadays, young people prefer to spend their time among friends rather than keeping in touch with distant relatives, ..

sentence_translations: Why Don’t Chinese People Like Relatives Anymore?
Many people know that Chinese people place great importance on family.
Having many relatives and frequent interactions is a major characteristic of Chinese families.
Especially during the Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival, relatives gathering together is an important family activity.
But in recent years, young people in China increasingly dislike their relatives. Why is this?
In China, relatives refer to people who are related by blood, including grandparents, uncles, aunts, and so on.
Of course, an uncle’s wife and an uncle’s children are also relatives.
Blood relations within five generations are all considered relatives.
Therefore, for Chinese people, it is very common to have dozens or even hundreds of relatives.
In the past society, relatives often lived not far from each other.
During major life events such as getting married, having children, and building a house, relatives would come to help.
Everyone helped each other, and they were very happy.
Therefore, the traditional practice of visiting relatives was something that made people feel happy.
However, in recent decades, urbanization in China has been rapid.
Many people move to live in the city, and the chances of meeting relatives have decreased, ..
.. so the relationship is not as close as before.
For people living in the city, most of life’s problems can be solved with money, so there’s no need for relatives to help out.
On the other hand, city life is busier than rural life and there isn’t as much time to keep in touch with relatives.
For those who remain in the countryside, relatives are still very important.
Everyone is willing to get along as before, chatting and gossiping together.
Such changes have led to some conflicts among relatives:
Some feel that their relatives are impolite, while others feel that they lack human kindness.
Especially for some young people, ..
.. they feel that meeting, eating, and chatting with people they don’t know well or people with different opinions, ..
..  even though these people are relatives, is not interesting at all.
So they sometimes dislike their relatives.
Nowadays, young people prefer to spend their time among friends rather than keeping in touch with distant relatives, ..
.. leading to the phenomenon of “cutting off family ties”.
